headline: Nvidia Shield TV Pro price rises $100 to $299.99 amid AI memory shortage
summary: The seven-year-old Nvidia Shield TV Pro's price rose $100, from $199.99 to $299.99, which outlets attribute to an AI-driven memory shortage pushing up component costs across streaming devices and other electronics.

claims.statement: The Nvidia Shield TV Pro's price increased by $100 to $299.99.
